scripts.archive: cp package.json dist/package.json && cd dist && zip -r ../lambda.zip .
scripts.package:js: npm run build && npm run archive
scripts.package:mjs: npm run build && mv dist/index.js dist/index.mjs && npm run archive
scripts.upload: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME" --zip-file fileb://lambda.zip && aws lambda wait function-updated --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME"
scripts.deploy:js: npm run package:js && npm run upload
scripts.deploy:mjs: npm run package:mjs && npm run upload
